messages:
amelia (AE): Heads-up — LumenHealth sent an RFI this morning. They want to run a 2-week POC that demonstrates: private deployment in their VPC, HSM-backed key management (PKCS#11), 7yr audit log retention, and a throughput target of ~80 QPS for embeddings + 30 QPS for generation. They also asked for a capability matrix and a rough POC cost. Can we pull this together by EOD tomorrow?
priya (Sales Eng): Thanks — quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do they require FedRAMP or just enterprise SOC/ISO docs? 2) HSM — BYOH (customer HSM) or Redwood-managed HSM with customer keys? 3) Which model family do they want to evaluate (embeddings + LLM)?
amelia (AE): They called out "FedRAMP in-scope eventually" but initial doesn't require FedRAMP yes/no. For HSM they prefer BYOH if possible but said they'd consider Redwood-managed if we provide an HSM SLA. Model: they want a medium-latency gen model + semantic embeddings for search — I suggested rw-13b-quantized-v1 for generation and rw-embed-3 for embeddings.
devon (SRE): BYOH w/ PKCS#11 is doable but needs network peering and a short runbook for secure tunnels. For the POC capacity, dedicated pool with 4 x A10x or similar should hit the targets if batching is tuned. Need to confirm region and egress constraints. Also: audit log retention 7yrs — storage/retention pricing will be a separate line item.
marta (Solutions): I can draft the capability matrix (features vs requirements) and the RFI written responses. I'll include fields: HSM support (BYOH + Redwood-managed), KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS), private control plane options, peering patterns, data residency, audit logging details, and SLA notes.
amelia (AE): Customer region: us-east-1 is ok. Egress: they prefer no cross-region egress. POC start target: next Tue.
ops-bot: playbook-uploaded: "BYOH-HSM-playbook-v2.pdf" uploaded to /internal/ops/playbooks (link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/BYOH-HSM-playbook-v2)
priya (Sales Eng): For pricing: quick POC estimate — dedicated 2-week reservation for 4 GPUs + network peering + ops onboarding + 2 SE days. I'll draft a line-item estimate but need exact model and expected sequence lengths (embeddings seq ~512 tokens, gen average 256 tokens).
marta (Solutions): Draft matrix note: I'm going to make a small table for the RFI: columns = Requirement, Redwood capability, Notes/Limitations, Attachments. I'll attach the playbook + sample config snippets (fence code block). Example config snippet I plan to include:
```
# sample kv cache / hsm-binding snippet
deployment:
  mode: private
  vpc_peering: true
  kms:
    provider: "customer-hsm"
    pkcs11_endpoint: "tcp://10.0.5.23:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
devon (SRE): Couple of blockers to flag in the RFI: 1) BYOH latency to the HSM can add ~5-12ms per key op depending on network; 2) guaranteed HSM throughput needs validation — we should add a test plan step to validate 50-200 ops/sec during the POC; 3) peering provisioning can take 24-48hrs depending on their infra team.
amelia (AE): Good call — include those. Also they asked for a one-page summary they can share with procurement.
priya (Sales Eng): I'll take the cost lines + one-pager. Marta — can you hand me the capability matrix by EOD today so I can embed it in the one-pager?
marta (Solutions): Yep — I'll upload a draft to the RFI folder: /sales/lumenhealth/rfi-draft-v1 (link placeholder). Expect it in ~3 hours.
priya (Sales Eng): Pricing rough numbers (placeholder, will refine): Dedicated pool (4x GPUs) 2 weeks = $18,000; Peering/onboarding = $2,500; SE support (2 days) = $3,200; Audit storage ~ $150/mo (7yr retention line shows in TCO). I'll turn that into a formal quote once Marta confirms model/seq assumptions.
amelia (AE): Solid. Can someone add a quick test plan snippet to the RFI that validates: key wrap ops/sec, p95 token latency for gen at 256 tokens, embedding throughput at target QPS, and log delivery/retention correctness?
devon (SRE): I'll paste a short test-plan block into the doc after lunch. Also will note fallback plan: if BYOH isn't possible for POC, we can run Redwood-managed HSM with customer-supplied keys in an HSM-backed KMS and note the delta in the matrix.
amelia (AE): Great — LumenHealth asked for the packaged packet by Friday COB. If we can get draft earlier, I can pre-send the matrix. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
